candidate.name: exact raw-Q5 shared gate/up pack8 + SiLU
schedule: one local256 block owns one eight-column gate/up output pack
threads 0..127 execute the retained gate local128 pack8 schedule and threads 128..255 execute the retained up schedule with half-local k strides and reduction trees
each half preserves its existing Q5 coefficient hoist, [t,t+128] K order, four wave32 reductions, and serial wave 0..3 sum
gate and up totals round independently to BF16 before the existing g * sigmoid(g) * u expression and final BF16 round
the fused leaf writes shared_intermediate directly and does not materialize shared_gate/shared_up
candidate.unfused_fallback: registered Q5 pack8 linear_pair plus silu_mul_separate; mandatory for rows>1, gfx1151, registry/shape miss, explicit rollback, and layer-47 Q6 shared gate/up

candidate_ranking.candidate: Q5 shared pack8 pair + exact SiLU
candidate_ranking.reason: block-local synchronization, 46 removable launches, measured stable pair-to-SiLU gaps at every context, and existing IQ/T16 exact dual-SiLU precedent
requires completion across 1,536 producer workgroups per layer; D11 showed self-resetting global producer counters can improve a local window without improving total kernel sum

candidate_ranking.candidate: IQ3 weighted down + D9 aggregate tail
candidate_ranking.reason: requires completion across 3,072 output workgroups and reorders the shared branch; weighted routing and the downstream D9 boundary are already independently fused

candidate_ranking.candidate: new IQ2 geometry or integer-dot decode
candidate_ranking.reason: retained branchless/pair16/local64/tile2 path already halves the original leaf; task32/local32 and inclusive Q8_1+sudot4 were measured rejections

micro: 50 warmups/mode, 15 counterbalanced repetitions, at least 300 launches/sample on actual blk.1 and blk.46 weights
both endpoint layers must improve HIP-event and synchronized wall against inclusive pair+separate-SiLU
trace must show local256, VGPR<=96, LDS<=2048, scratch0, and exactly 46 fused calls/token
model: all 48 post-layer hidden rows, full logits/argmax bits, final/post-layer hidden, complete K/V and KVLiveSpans, reset, and lifecycle exact
clean short/512/1K/near-4K kernel sum and dispatch span improve with 729 classified dispatches/token
complete ten-prompt/four-category counterbalanced h16/h32 gate is exact and non-regressive before default promotion
red: missing four-axis wrapper/key for the fused rank-2 Q5 pair
synthetic K3072/N1024 BF16 output must equal pack8 pair plus silu_mul_separate bit-for-bit, including adversarial sigmoid and BF16-boundary values
actual blk.1 and blk.46 shared weights must be BF16-bit exact
runtime plan must select only gfx1100 c1 raw-Q5 equal pairs; Q6, rows>1, gfx1151, and registry/shape misses must execute the unfused chain
implementation_gate.retention: promote only after all gates; otherwise remove the fused route and retain D12 pair+separate fallback without default-off debt

measured_ceiling.interpretation: The exact block-local fusion has a measured 0.175 ms/token gap-only opportunity and a strict 0.259 ms/token zero-increment post-op ceiling, materially closing 42.3-62.5% of D12's 0.414 ms gap. It cannot claim 50 tok/s before implementation; the modeled range is 49.41-49.62 tok/s.

rejected_geometry_transfer.reason: The smaller K3072/N1024 shared shape does not inherit D12's wide-projection win.
